# REMO World (https://remoworld.com)

> REMO World is a free bilingual (English & French) 4D World Cities platform combining 4D Focus TV Ambient City Windows, Synced Pomodoro Lofi Study Rooms, 56 ad-free live World City Radio stations across 24 metropolises, 1910 vs 2026 historical city Time-Warp comparisons, a 30-Second Daily City Challenge, Daily World Blitz 60s trivia with 1v1 duels, My Travel Score (/24) checklist, Soul City personality quiz, Dual-City First-Class 4D Boarding Pass generator, and a free embeddable Notion & Blog Live City Widget Studio.

## Key Free Features & Studios (Zero Sign-Up Required to Explore)
- [REMO World Live Social App](https://remoworld.com/): Real-time cross-city social feed, 1910 vs 2026 Before/After visual moments, 30s Daily City Challenge (`?open=daily`), live City Wars, Citizen Passports, and collectible 4D City Cards.
- [4D Focus TV — Ambient City Windows & Zen Clock](https://remoworld.com/focus-tv.html): Fullscreen 4D Focus TV window with rain/snow/neon/fireplace FX, Fly Random teleportation, Live Rain/Night city filters, Custom Vibe Links (`?tv=city&fx=rain`), and Minimal Zen Desk Clock mode.
- [Synced Study Together Rooms](https://remoworld.com/study-room.html): Shareable Focus Together Room URLs (`?tv=tokyo&fx=rain&room=study42`) with synchronized Pomodoro sessions and ad-free Lofi radio.
- [My Travel Score (/24) World Checklist](https://remoworld.com/travel-score.html): Interactive 24-city visited checklist with Explorer Tiers and free 9:16 HD Story PNG export (`?open=travelmap`).
- [Soul City Personality Quiz](https://remoworld.com/soul-city-quiz.html): 5-question personality quiz matching visitors to 1 of 24 world cities with 6 archetypes and a 9:16 HD Soul City certificate (`?open=soulcity`).
- [4D Panoramic Dual-City Boarding Pass Generator](https://remoworld.com/boarding-pass.html): Create & download First-Class 9:16 Story Boarding Passes with dual-city skylines, jetliner artwork, live clocks, and flight time (`?open=boardingpass&dep=chisinau&arr=montreal`).
- [Free Notion & Blog Live City Widget Studio](https://remoworld.com/widget.html): Embed a live world city clock, Open-Meteo real-time °C weather, and 1-click local radio badge into Notion or any HTML site (24 cities × 4 neon themes × EN/FR).
- [Daily World Blitz 60s & 1v1 Duels](https://remoworld.com/world-blitz.html): 5 daily world cities solved in 60 seconds with shareable Wordle-style result cards and URL-encoded 1v1 challenge links (`?open=blitz&vs=...`).
- [REMO Odyssey Official 4D World Runner](https://remoworld.com/odyssey.html): Browser action & hover-coin game across 24 real city skylines with live weather surges and 1v1 Ghost duels.
- [Free Live World Cities Radio (56 Stations)](https://remoworld.com/world-radio.html): Stream live radio from Paris, Montréal, Chișinău (RMO — 8 live stations), Bucharest (OTP), New York, London, Tokyo, Seoul, Berlin, Dubai, Lisbon, Amsterdam, Sydney, Rio, Singapore & Cairo + Lofi, Jazz & Synthwave.
- [Guess The City Photo Game](https://remoworld.com/guess-the-city.html): Free browser geography & skyline photo guessing game created by real citizens worldwide.
- [Top 24 World Cities Live Ranking & City Comparisons](https://remoworld.com/world-ranking.html): Real-time city standings, interactive [City Versus Duels](https://remoworld.com/city-versus.html), and 12 dedicated head-to-head city comparison guides.
- [Official REMO City Ambassadors Program](https://remoworld.com/ambassadors.html): Founding program for city creators and Study With Me streamers.
- [All 24 Connected World Cities Directory](https://remoworld.com/cities/index.html): Live local time, weather, 1910 vs 2026 history, verified facts, radio streams & urban stats for every Edition-1 metropolis.

## Detailed City Profiles (24 Cities — 1910 vs 2026 & Facts)
### ⚜️ Montréal / Montréal (YUL) — Canada
- Tagline (EN): Cyber-Creative Capital & Mount Royal Summit
- Tagline (FR): Capitale Cyber-Créative & Sommet du Mont-Royal
- Summary: Bilingual hub of AI innovation, festival lights, geodesic architecture, and iconic midnight gastronomy.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, Montréal was Canada’s commercial powerhouse, where electric streetcars clattered down Saint-Catherine Street beneath the neo-Gothic twin towers of Notre-Dame Basilica and the stone facades of Old Montréal. By 2026, the city has fused that European stone heritage with one of the world’s premier AI research ecosystems, illuminated winter festivals, and the 33 km RÉSO underground pedestrian network beneath Mount Royal.
- Verified Facts: Home to RÉSO — a 33 km climate-controlled underground pedestrian city beneath winter snow. | Second-largest French-speaking metropolis in the world after Paris, celebrated for bilingual culture. | Municipal bylaws protect the silhouette of Mount Royal so no skyscraper rises above its summit cross.
- Rarity: Mythic 4D | Element: neon
- Urban Ratings: Culture 95/100, Nightlife 92/100, Tech 96/100, Gastronomy 94/100
- Direct Hub: https://remoworld.com/cities/montreal.html

### 🗼 Paris / Paris (CDG) — France
- Tagline (EN): City of Light, Haute Couture & Golden Horizon
- Tagline (FR): Ville Lumière, Haute Couture & Horizon Doré
- Summary: Timeless elegance crowned by the Iron Lady, avant-garde galleries, Seine nights, and Michelin artistry.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, Belle Époque Paris gleamed with freshly opened Art Nouveau Métro entrances, horse-drawn carriages circling the Arc de Triomphe, and a 21-year-old Eiffel Tower anchoring the skyline. In 2026, the City of Light preserves Haussmann’s golden limestone symmetry while pioneering bikeable Seine riverbanks, green urban corridors, and world-leading haute gastronomy and art.
- Verified Facts: Spanned by 37 historic bridges across the Seine River, with Pont Neuf ironically being the oldest (1607). | Contains more than 450 public parks, botanical gardens, and hidden courtyard squares across 20 arrondissements. | Thermal expansion makes the iron Eiffel Tower grow up to 15 cm taller during hot summer afternoons.
- Rarity: Mythic 4D | Element: crystal
- Urban Ratings: Culture 99/100, Nightlife 90/100, Tech 88/100, Gastronomy 99/100
- Direct Hub: https://remoworld.com/cities/paris.html

### 🇲🇩 Chișinău / Chișinău (RMO) — Moldova
- Tagline (EN): Green Capital of Moldova • Triumphal Arch & Wine Vaults
- Tagline (FR): Capitale Verte de Moldavie • Arc de Triomphe & Caves Royales
- Summary: Vibrant Eastern European capital famed for its white-stone City Gates, Triumphal Arch, underground wine cities, and rising IT talent.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, Chișinău was an elegant limestone capital designed with wide neoclassical boulevards by architect Alexander Bernardazzi, anchored by the 1841 Triumphal Arch and lush central gardens. By 2026, Chișinău (IATA: RMO) pairs its iconic white-stone City Gates and park-lined avenues with a rapidly expanding European IT park, boutique specialty coffee culture, and world-record wine tourism.
- Verified Facts: Minutes from Mileștii Mici & Cricova — over 200 km of subterranean limestone wine tunnels holding world-record collections. | Ranks among Europe’s greenest capitals, dotted with 23+ tranquil lakes, botanical parks, and tree-lined boulevards. | Chișinău’s 1841 Triumphal Arch houses a monumental clock cast from historic bronze bells that still chimes every hour.
- Rarity: Mythic 4D | Element: plasma
- Urban Ratings: Culture 94/100, Nightlife 89/100, Tech 91/100, Gastronomy 96/100
- Direct Hub: https://remoworld.com/cities/chisinau.html

### 🇷🇴 Bucharest / Bucarest (OTP) — Romania
- Tagline (EN): Little Paris of the East & Fiber-Speed Cyber Hub
- Tagline (FR): Petit Paris de l’Est & Pôle Cyber Ultra-Rapide
- Summary: Grand Belle Époque boulevards, the neoclassical Athenaeum, Old Town electric nights, and gigabit tech energy.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, Bucharest earned its nickname "Little Paris of the East" as French-trained architects lined Calea Victoriei with the Romanian Athenaeum, ornate Belle Époque palaces, and literary cafés. In 2026, Bucharest fuses those neoclassical landmarks with one of Europe’s fastest fiber-optic tech scenes, creative studios, and the electric late-night pulse of Lipscani Old Town.
- Verified Facts: The Palace of the Parliament is the heaviest building ever constructed on Earth, using millions of tons of marble and steel. | Earned the title "Little Paris" in the early 20th century for its Arcul de Triumf and Parisian-inspired boulevards. | Consistently ranks among Europe’s fastest gigabit fiber-optic capitals and top emerging software hubs.
- Rarity: Legendary Gold | Element: cyber
- Urban Ratings: Culture 91/100, Nightlife 95/100, Tech 94/100, Gastronomy 90/100
- Direct Hub: https://remoworld.com/cities/bucharest.html

### 🗽 New York / New York (JFK) — United States
- Tagline (EN): The Sleepless Metropolis & Neon Skyline
- Tagline (FR): La Métropole Qui Ne Dort Jamais
- Summary: Skyscraper canyons of Manhattan, Times Square voltage, Broadway icons, and global cultural gravity.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, New York City’s skyline was entering the skyscraper era with the newly completed Flatiron and Singer buildings while ferries and subway lines connected Manhattan’s five rising boroughs. In 2026, NYC’s supertall glass towers, glowing Times Square marquees, and greenway waterfronts form the world’s most linguistically diverse 24/7 cultural crossroads.
- Verified Facts: More than 800 languages are spoken across New York City’s five boroughs — the highest linguistic diversity on Earth. | Central Park spans 341 hectares in the heart of Manhattan — larger than the entire principality of Monaco. | The NYC Subway operates 24 hours a day, 365 days a year across 472 stations.
- Rarity: Mythic 4D | Element: neon
- Urban Ratings: Culture 96/100, Nightlife 98/100, Tech 95/100, Gastronomy 95/100
- Direct Hub: https://remoworld.com/cities/newyork.html

### 🏯 Tokyo / Tokyo (HND) — Japan
- Tagline (EN): Hyper-Neon Shibuya & Ancient Shinto Harmony
- Tagline (FR): Hyper-Néon de Shibuya & Harmonie Millénaire
- Summary: Where futuristic robotics, holographic crossings, and serene Torii shrines merge in dazzling precision.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, late-Meiji Tokyo combined wooden Edo neighborhoods, rickshaws, and tranquil temple grounds with brand-new red-brick Western avenues around Marunouchi and Ginza. By 2026, Tokyo is a luminous masterpiece of quiet Shinto shrines standing beside Shibuya’s neon canyons, precision bullet trains, and unmatched culinary artistry.
- Verified Facts: Shibuya Scramble Crossing sees up to 3,000 pedestrians cross simultaneously during a single peak green light. | Holds more Michelin-starred restaurants than any other city on Earth, alongside legendary late-night ramen counters. | Features roughly one high-tech vending machine for every 30 residents, serving everything from hot coffee to umbrellas.
- Rarity: Mythic 4D | Element: cyber
- Urban Ratings: Culture 97/100, Nightlife 95/100, Tech 99/100, Gastronomy 98/100
- Direct Hub: https://remoworld.com/cities/tokyo.html

### 🏰 London / Londres (LHR) — United Kingdom
- Tagline (EN): Royal Thames Skyline & Global FinTech Crown
- Tagline (FR): Horizon Royal de la Tamise & Couronne FinTech
- Summary: Big Ben chimes beside futuristic glass towers, underground soundwaves, and world-leading museums.
- 1910 vs 2026 Evolution: In 1910, Edwardian London buzzed with iconic red omnibuses, steam trains beneath Victorian iron stations, and the unmistakable silhouette of Big Ben and Tower Bridge over the Thames. In 2026, glass architectural icons like The Shard reflect centuries of royal stone heritage, 170+ world-class museums, and a vibrant global FinTech and music capital.
- Verified Facts: The London Underground opened in 1863, making the Tube the oldest subterranean metro network in the world. | Home to over 170 world-class museums and galleries — including the British Museum and Tate Modern — many with free entry. | With over 8 million trees across parks and boulevards, London meets the UN definition of an urban forest.
